from docx.shared import Pt, RGBColor, Inches
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()
st = doc.styles["Normal"]
st.font.name = "Calibri"
st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
for s in ["Heading 1","Heading 2","Heading 3"]:
    doc.styles[s].font.name = "Calibri"
    doc.styles[s].font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F)
doc.styles["Heading 1"].font.size = Pt(15)
doc.styles["Heading 2"].font.size = Pt(12.5)
doc.styles["Heading 3"].font.size = Pt(11)
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(0.9)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(0.9)

def shade(cell, hexcolor):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd")
    shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), hexcolor)
    tcPr.append(shd)

def add_runs(p, text):
    # **bold** markup
    parts = text.split("**")
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        if part:
            r = p.add_run(part)
            if i % 2 == 1: r.bold = True
    return p

def para(text, bold=False, italic=False, size=None, align=None, space_after=6):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    add_runs(p, text)
    for r in p.runs:
        if bold: r.bold = True
        if italic: r.italic = True
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
    if align == "center": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    return p

def bullet(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def numbered(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    add_runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(3)
    return p

def h(text, level=1):
    return doc.add_heading(text, level=level)

TIERCOL = {"EXACT":"F4B6B6","UNSCREEN":"F8CBAD","STRONG":"FFE699","WEAK":"FFF2CC","CLEAR":"C6E0B4"}

def table(headers, rows, widths=None, fs=8.5, tiercol=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(headers))
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    for i, hd in enumerate(headers):
        c = t.rows[0].cells[i]
        c.text = ""
        add_runs(c.paragraphs[0], hd)
        for r in c.paragraphs[0].runs:
            r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fs); r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
        shade(c, "1F3A5F")
    for row in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        for i, val in enumerate(row):
            cells[i].text = ""
            lines = str(val).split("\n")
            for j, line in enumerate(lines):
                p = cells[i].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[i].add_paragraph()
                add_runs(p, line)
                for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(fs)
        if tiercol is not None:
            v = str(row[tiercol]).upper()
            key = "UNSCREEN" if "UNSCREEN" in v else "EXACT" if "EXACT" in v else "STRONG" if "STRONG" in v else "WEAK" if "WEAK" in v else "CLEAR" if ("CLEAR" in v or "NO MATCH" in v) else None
            if key: shade(cells[tiercol], TIERCOL[key])
    # repeat header
    trPr = t.rows[0]._tr.get_or_add_trPr()
    th = OxmlElement("w:tblHeader"); th.set(qn("w:val"), "true"); trPr.append(th)
    if widths:
        for row in t.rows:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                row.cells[i].width = Inches(w)
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def kv(rows, w=(1.9, 4.8), fs=9):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=0, cols=2)
    t.style = "Table Grid"
    for k, v in rows:
        cells = t.add_row().cells
        cells[0].text = ""; cells[1].text = ""
        add_runs(cells[0].paragraphs[0], k)
        for r in cells[0].paragraphs[0].runs: r.bold = True; r.font.size = Pt(fs)
        shade(cells[0], "DCE6F1")
        lines = str(v).split("\n")
        for j, line in enumerate(lines):
            p = cells[1].paragraphs[0] if j == 0 else cells[1].add_paragraph()
            add_runs(p, line)
            for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(fs)
    for row in t.rows:
        row.cells[0].width = Inches(w[0]); row.cells[1].width = Inches(w[1])
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def footer_text(text):
    for s in doc.sections:
        p = s.footer.paragraphs[0]
        p.text = text
        p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
        for r in p.runs: r.font.size = Pt(7.5)
